prompt:
Locked-off camera. A round pub table with pints and an answer sheet. Centre, the blonde woman in the turquoise fleece with a pink collar faces the camera, one hand raised. Left, the older man in the tweed jacket and green tie; behind right, the man in glasses and the navy gilet; front right, the grey-haired man in the olive waterproof. The men turn their heads toward her and settle into a flat stare. She draws her shoulders up a little, lifts both hands slightly, palms toward them, and says "I plead the Fifth." briskly, then gives a small guilty grin and glances down at her pint. Only her mouth moves for words. The men stay silent with mouths closed: the man in glasses raises one eyebrow, the tweed man leans back a fraction, the man in the waterproof keeps staring without blinking. Same room, same warm light, only the people already in the frame, the picture clean. Understated, believable pub moment; photographic.
Thanks.
